## Independent re-review

Authoritative main remains `00872520036da38fd1809a9abf61f56d2344fcb5`, exactly the PT-6R1 once-bound execution base. PR #252 is open, non-draft and mergeable at reviewed head `2b63e79d91548e5e87b48ad9c1bf353467349d12`. No main drift was observed.

Review `6031593870` already accepted the PT-6R1 engineering implementation and real-MariaDB evidence at head `9e668a5cd4bce17e2808b82b2521cc58c6d08894`. The only blocker was stale post-merge phase authority.

The new head is exactly one commit ahead of that engineering-accepted head and changes only six governance/summary files:

- `.agents/programs/product-trust-v1.yml`
- `.agents/state/product-trust-v1.json`
- `.agents/work-packages/product-trust-pt-6r1-first-user-identity-concurrency-v1.yml`
- `docs/AI_PROJECT_STATE.md`
- `docs/evaluation/product-trust-pt-6r1-first-user-identity-concurrency.md`
- `docs/plans/active/product-trust-modernization.md`

No PT-6R1 production code, test code, raw before/after evidence, historical PT-2/PT-6 evidence, schema, workflow, frontend, model/RAG, cloud or infrastructure file changed after the accepted engineering head.

### Governance blocker closure — PASS

The durable repository contract now correctly pauses progression after PT-6R1:

- `PT-6R2 auto_start_after_dependencies: false`;
- `human_gate_before_start: PRODUCT_TRUST_EVIDENCE_VALIDITY_REASSESSMENT`;
- PT-6R2 activation requires PT-6R1 acceptance/USER merge plus a subsequent evidence-validity amendment that is reviewed, explicitly USER-approved, independently accepted and USER-merged;
- durable state has `executionAuthorized: false`, `executionStarted: false`, no Work Package and no execution base for PT-6R2;
- `nextEligiblePhase` remains null;
- automatic Goal continuation is false and paused at the evidence-validity gate;
- PT-6R1 Work Package selects no next phase and records PT-6R2 as blocked;
- no future amendment content, Program version or execution base is preselected.

This satisfies the exact blocker from review `6031593870`. A future agent reading repository SSOT can no longer legitimately auto-start PT-6R2 immediately after this merge.

### Engineering evidence remains accepted — PASS

The previously reviewed PT-6R1 evidence remains unchanged:

- first invalid Mockito instrumentation attempt preserved;
- exactly one USER-authorized additional real-MariaDB before-state;
- valid reproduction of immediate IDENTITY save uniqueness failure + rollback-only poisoned Hibernate recovery session;
- smallest REQUIRES_NEW transaction-boundary correction;
- one same-condition real-MariaDB after-state with both callers converging to one USER/ACTIVE user and same userId;
- identity, distinct-identity, email-conflict, display-name and PT-5 access invariants preserved;
- no additional database execution or rerun-until-green.

The prior engineering-head validation remains the relevant execution evidence: focused identity 17 PASS, real MariaDB/schema 4 PASS, PT-5 access 87 PASS, full backend 557 tests with zero failures/errors and four external-MariaDB skips, plus successful Backend Local Verification and Terraform Static Verification at the engineering head.

The new governance-only commit intentionally did not rerun those behavioral validations. Because the delta is confined to the six non-production governance/summary files above and the accepted implementation/evidence bytes are unchanged, lack of duplicate exact-head behavioral CI is not an acceptance blocker.

## Decision

**ACCEPTED / PASS. USER merge of PR #252 is recommended.**

After merge, do not activate PT-6R2. The next mandatory state is:

`HUMAN_REQUIRED: PRODUCT_TRUST_EVIDENCE_VALIDITY_REASSESSMENT`

No live model, GCP, OpenSearch, deployment, IAM/security or destructive authority is granted by this review.
